description:
Summary of the Role:

Maze is building the AI-native platform for application and cloud security. Our agents investigate every finding the way an expert would - working out what's actually reachable and exploitable - so security and engineering teams fix the handful of issues that matter instead of drowning in thousands that don't. Maze Code, our AppSec product covering SCA, SAST and secrets, is now generally available and leads the large majority of our new opportunities.

 

We're hiring an Account Executive to own a fast-moving mid-market book. This isn't a seven-figure, eighteen-month enterprise seat. You'll run a high volume of $40K–$50K deals with high-growth tech companies and smaller enterprises, often replacing a legacy AppSec tool the team has outgrown, and you'll close them in weeks rather than quarters. You'll join an existing team of AEs, sales engineers and technical success, with a defined ICP, target accounts, contracts and pricing in place, and the room to make the motion faster and better as you go.

 

The right person is early in an upward career trajectory, has a track record of beating quota on shorter-cycle technical deals, and works harder than the territory requires. If you'd rather close fifteen deals a year than chase two, this is the role.

 

Your Contribution:

  • Own a quota-carrying mid-market territory end to end, from first touch through discovery, a short proof of value, pricing and signature. Your success will be measured by new ARR booked against quota.

  • Build a meaningful share of your own pipeline. Work the strategic accounts we assign each month, follow up event and inbound leads fast, and run your own outbound into AppSec, product security and platform engineering teams.

  • Run a tight, high-velocity process. Keep many deals moving at once, qualify out early, and keep cycle times short without leaving value on the table.

  • Sell the business case, not the feature list. Show buyers how Maze cuts noise and engineering effort, and how a consolidated AppSec platform at a fixed annual price compares with what they run today.

  • Work in sync with your sales engineer on demos and proofs of value, and hand customers over cleanly to technical success so they renew and expand.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate so your forecast is something leadership can plan around.

  • Feed what you hear back into the company - objections, competitor moves, pricing pressure, missing features - so product and marketing get sharper every quarter.

 

What You Need to Be Successful:

  • 2–5 years in a closing role selling a technical B2B product, with a consistent record of hitting or beating quota. We'll want to see the numbers.

  • Experience selling security, developer tools or infrastructure software to technical buyers. AppSec or DevSecOps is ideal.

  • Comfort with velocity: you've run a high-volume book of five-figure deals with short cycles, not only a handful of strategic accounts.

  • Pipeline you built yourself. You can point to deals you sourced through outbound and network, not just ones handed to you.

  • A high work rate and genuine self-direction. Plenty of what you need will exist; some won't. When there's no one-pager or script for something, you write it and keep moving.

  • Technical enough to hold the first conversation with an AppSec engineer about vulnerabilities, reachability and developer workflow, and credible with the engineering leader who signs.

  • Coachability. You want direct feedback and act on it quickly.

  • Nice to Haves:

    • Time at a well-run security company with a strong mid-market motion (think Wiz, Snyk, Darktrace or similar), or as an early rep at a fast-growing security startup.

    • Experience displacing an incumbent AppSec vendor.

    • Started out as an SDR or BDR, so outbound is muscle memory.

    • An existing network across high-growth tech companies in your region.

 

Why Join Us:

  • Building at the intersection of generative AI and cybersecurity, with a product that practitioners can see working in their own code within days.

  • A motion that's ready to scale. Maze Code gives you a simpler story, faster proofs of value and quicker cycles, so you can get to productivity quickly.

  • Well-funded Series A startup with hands-on leaders from Big Tech and scale-ups, who've been part of leadership teams behind multiple acquisitions and an IPO.

  • Cybersecurity is a force for good - every deal you close helps a team stop real attacks.

  • Room to grow fast. We're scaling the sales team significantly in 2027. Strong early reps will have a direct line into how it's built, and the chance to grow with it.
